market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101-105 May 4 with peaks at $107. To hit a 'low' of $95 requires a ~6-10% pullback. Strong supply shock (Persian Gulf 9.1 mbpd disruption, Hormuz tensions) keeps prices elevated, but volatility is high. Estimate ~40%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Diplomatic resolution or ceasefire could trigger fast unwind
